title: a missing file fails with the same FileSystemFailure text on every engine
purpose: Reading a missing file through FileContent and through File gives FileSystemFailure.detailed("not_found", "Cannot open file"); the message names the operation, the code the reason.

stdout.text:
FileSystemFailure.detailed("not_found", "Cannot open file")
FileSystemFailure.detailed("not_found", "Cannot open file")

provenance.expected_basis: Decision on #319: one phrase per host operation on every engine (the IR engine's and the JVM's), the reason in the code.
